verdict.rationale: Dover's own AI applicant scoring ranks candidates in the user's pipeline, which is an in-product AI suggestion derived from the user's data. It is a premium feature, and the docs describe it in only a single line. The other AI features generate content (careers pages, job descriptions) or take notes rather than surface insights, and the reporting on candidates, costs, and conversion is not described as AI-driven. Missing for 10: broader AI-generated insights or recommendations across hiring data (e.g., pipeline or conversion analysis), detail on how scoring explanations are presented, availability outside the paid tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI applicant scoring promotes the best people to the top
Premium is $199/month and adds AI applicant scoring, the AI notetaker
